## Document Ingestion Workflow

This workflow:
1. Scrapes Rhythm Engineering website pages
2. Extracts and chunks text
3. Creates embeddings via OpenAI
4. Stores in Supabase vector database

**To add PDF ingestion:**
- Use the "Read Binary Files" node to read PDFs
- Use "Extract from File" node to get text
- Connect to the chunking logic

**Run this workflow manually to populate the knowledge base.**
